title: Symbolic derivation: Hilbert action -> double-null Einstein-scalar system
action: S = (1/2kappa) int sqrt(-g) R + S_m,  S_m = -1/2 int sqrt(-g) (grad Phi)^2
hilbert_tensor: T_{mu nu} = Phi_mu Phi_nu - 1/2 g_{mu nu} (grad Phi)^2
boxPhi: 4*(-r(u, v)*Derivative(Phi(u, v), u, v) - Derivative(Phi(u, v), u)*Derivative(r(u, v), v) - Derivative(Phi(u, v), v)*Derivative(r(u, v), u))/(alpha(u, v)**2*r(u, v))

hilbert_identity.0: 4*(-r(u, v)*Derivative(Phi(u, v), u, v) - Derivative(Phi(u, v), u)*Derivative(r(u, v), v) - Derivative(Phi(u, v), v)*Derivative(r(u, v), u))*Derivative(Phi(u, v), u)/(alpha(u, v)**2*r(u, v))
hilbert_identity.1: 4*(-r(u, v)*Derivative(Phi(u, v), u, v) - Derivative(Phi(u, v), u)*Derivative(r(u, v), v) - Derivative(Phi(u, v), v)*Derivative(r(u, v), u))*Derivative(Phi(u, v), v)/(alpha(u, v)**2*r(u, v))

system_solved.C1_r_uu: -kappa*r(u, v)*Derivative(Phi(u, v), u)**2/2 + 2*Derivative(omega(u, v), u)*Derivative(r(u, v), u)
system_solved.C2_r_vv: -kappa*r(u, v)*Derivative(Phi(u, v), v)**2/2 + 2*Derivative(omega(u, v), v)*Derivative(r(u, v), v)
system_solved.UV_r_uv: (-exp(2*omega(u, v))/4 - Derivative(r(u, v), u)*Derivative(r(u, v), v))/r(u, v)
system_solved.TH_omega_uv: -kappa*Derivative(Phi(u, v), u)*Derivative(Phi(u, v), v)/2 - Derivative(r(u, v), u, v)/r(u, v)
system_solved.UV_closed_r_uv: (-exp(2*omega(u, v))/4 - Derivative(r(u, v), u)*Derivative(r(u, v), v))/r(u, v)

units: kappa = 8 pi G; numerical code uses kappa = 2 (4 pi G = 1, Burko normalization)
